An absolute blast to play!

What makes the game so enjoyable is how naturally its systems connect. Production, mixing recipes, customer management, distribution, and business expansion all contribute to a surprisingly satisfying gameplay loop. Every new property, employee, or automation upgrade gives you another reason to keep expanding.

The progression is particularly rewarding. Starting with practically nothing and gradually building an efficient operation feels genuinely satisfying. Experimenting with different product combinations adds another layer of depth, while managing supplies, customers, and law enforcement keeps things interesting.

Co-op makes the experience even better. Splitting responsibilities with friends, optimizing production, and occasionally turning a perfectly organized operation into complete chaos creates some unforgettable moments.

Of course, being an Early Access title, there's still room for improvement. Certain activities can become repetitive, and the automation and management systems could benefit from further refinement.

Current state of the game - version 0.4.7. 

I recomment the game on a discount. It has been fun so far. I would describe it as a simulator with extra steps. Game gets updated once in a while, but has plenty of room to polish and improve. It is an EA after all..

Basic gameplay is nice. Mechanics are fun, later tedious, but game solves that with better stations or workers. So far the game is easy, maybe too easy. What i mean by this: 

Police is annoying (curfew), but that's about it. Their vision is somehow supernatural at night, maybe that should be fixed and have some other police methods come in.

Fighting cartel feels scary at first, but you quickly realise it's not. You only end up losing some money, but that's about it. I didnt finish the game, but i doubt it progresses more than it did until now.

Junkies give way too much money. If you ask for 100€/piece, they often overpay about 50% (number i made up, but that gives a perspective). As a dealer, you are happy, but i doubt that's how street junkies operate.

Gameplay is smooth, steamdeck is playable, but not optimal. Few bugs here and there, some stations are a nightmare to play on steamdeck.

review:
It's a good game, but every time there's an update, the co-op save file with the boys gets corrupted. The host can load in fine, but the others get stuck loading on one of the various "Loading NPC Behaviors" type loading screens. With the game still being Early Access, and getting updates fairly frequently, this happens too often for us to be able to justify restarting a new game every single time.

It's a fun game for single player, and good between updates, so I still recommend getting it if you're thinking about it, but if you're just looking for a game to play for a couple hours every Saturday with the boys, it's going to be more frustrating than it's worth until the sync error is solved.
